parameters.query: SELECT id, patient_name, doctor_name, appointment_date, appointment_time FROM appointments WHERE (patient_phone = $1 OR patient_name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%') AND status != 'iptal' ORDER BY appointment_date DESC LIMIT 1
